_comment: A quarter of a mat, as vanilla's leaf litter lies a quarter at a time (`template_leaf_litter_1` to `_4`),
laid flat in the top of the water block. Vanilla's glow lichen under a tint of ours until the asset pass.
**`light_emission` is fixed and the block's own light level is not**: the mat is drawn full-bright at every
hour, so a night lake reads as red specks in a black cavern, while what it radiates follows
`AlgaeBlock.isLitAtHour`. One is what you can see, the other is what you can see by.
